description: Update a 3PL client by id. Every field is preserve-on-omit — omitting a field keeps the client's current value (it is NOT cleared). Changing code re-checks uniqueness. Requires an operator (unpinned) org token on a 3PL tenant.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

input.description: Fields to change; omitted fields keep their current value.

annualHoldingCostRatePctOverride.description: Per-client annual carrying-cost rate percent (0-100); omit to keep.

code.description: New unique code; omit to keep.

externalFeedExpectedCadenceHours.description: Expected external-feed cadence hours (1-8760); omit to keep.

externalFeedSource.description: External-feed source label; omit to keep.

externalFeedStalenessThresholdHours.description: External-feed staleness window hours (1-2160); omit to keep.

idealOrderCadenceDaysOverride.description: Per-client order cadence days (1-3650); omit to keep.

managementMode.description: pssc_managed or publisher_managed; omit to keep.

name.description: New name; omit to keep the current value.

optionMethodologyOverride.description: Per-client run-option methodology (BalancedReturn, CashPreservation, or ProfitFirst); omit to keep.

orderHorizonMonths.description: Order horizon months (1-120); omit to keep.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing is changed until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.

name: update_client
title: Update Client
